task.instructions:
Create a Python script to generate a 3D scatter plot from a CSV file named "data.csv" with columns ["0-60 mph(sec)", "Gas Mileage(mpg)", "Power(kW)", "Weight(kg)", "Engine Displacement(cc)"]. The plot should meet the following specifications:
- Plot each car as a point in 3D space using its acceleration time, gas mileage, and power as coordinates.
- Point sizes should increase with the engine displacement, and colors should vary from one end of the spectrum (like purple) for smaller engines to the other end (like yellow) for larger engines.
- Add flat projections of these points onto the XY, ZX, and YZ planes below and to the sides of the 3D points, colored blue, red, and green, respectively.
- Include a color bar to indicate the relationship between color and engine displacement.
- Label each axis to show what it represents and use a 3D perspective for viewing the plot.
- Ensure the plot has a modern and clean design, with clear, semi-transparent points to avoid visual clutter.

import matplotlib
matplotlib.use("Agg")
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from matplotlib.colors import Normalize
from matplotlib.cm import ScalarMappable

# Read the CSV file
df = pd.read_csv("data.csv")

# Extract the relevant columns
x = df["0-60 mph(sec)"]  # Acceleration time
y = df["Gas Mileage(mpg)"]  # Gas mileage
z = df["Power(kW)"]  # Power
sizes = df["Engine Displacement(cc)"]  # Engine displacement for size
colors = df["Engine Displacement(cc)"]  # Engine displacement for color

# Create a figure with a custom layout
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(16, 10))
fig.suptitle("3D Car Performance Analysis", fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=0.98)

# Create a grid for subplots
# Main 3D plot in the center
# XY projection below
# ZX projection to the left
# YZ projection to the right
gs = fig.add_gridspec(2, 2, width_ratios=[1, 1.2], height_ratios=[1, 1])

# 3D scatter plot
ax3d = fig.add_subplot(gs[:, 0], projection='3d')

# Normalize colors based on engine displacement
norm = Normalize(vmin=colors.min(), vmax=colors.max())
cmap = plt.cm.get_cmap('viridis')  # Using viridis which goes from purple to yellow

# Create scatter plot with 3D projection
scatter = ax3d.scatter(x, y, z, 
                       s=sizes * 0.5,  # Scale sizes for visibility
                       c=colors, 
                       cmap=cmap, 
                       norm=norm,
                       alpha=0.6,
                       edgecolors='none')

# Set labels
ax3d.set_xlabel('0-60 mph (sec)', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')
ax3d.set_ylabel('Gas Mileage (mpg)', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')
ax3d.set_zlabel('Power (kW)', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')

# Set title
ax3d.set_title('3D Car Performance', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')

# Set view angle for better perspective
ax3d.view_init(elev=25, azim=45)

# XY Plane Projection (below)
ax_xy = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 0])
ax_xy.scatter(x, y, s=sizes * 0.5, c=colors, cmap=cmap, norm=norm, alpha=0.4, edgecolors='none')
ax_xy.set_xlabel('0-60 mph (sec)', fontsize=9)
ax_xy.set_ylabel('Gas Mileage (mpg)', fontsize=9)
ax_xy.set_title('XY Plane Projection', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')
ax_xy.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# ZX Plane Projection (to the left)
ax_zx = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 1], projection='3d')
ax_zx.scatter(z, x, s=sizes * 0.5, c=colors, cmap=cmap, norm=norm, alpha=0.4, edgecolors='none')
ax_zx.set_xlabel('Power (kW)', fontsize=9)
ax_zx.set_ylabel('0-60 mph (sec)', fontsize=9)
ax_zx.set_zlabel('Engine Displacement (cc)', fontsize=9)
ax_zx.set_title('ZX Plane Projection', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')
ax_zx.view_init(elev=20, azim=-60)

# YZ Plane Projection (to the right)
ax_yz = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 1])
ax_yz.scatter(y, z, s=sizes * 0.5, c=colors, cmap=cmap, norm=norm, alpha=0.4, edgecolors='none')
ax_yz.set_xlabel('Gas Mileage (mpg)', fontsize=9)
ax_yz.set_ylabel('Power (kW)', fontsize=9)
ax_yz.set_title('YZ Plane Projection', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')
ax_yz.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# Add color bar
cbar_ax = fig.add_axes([0.92, 0.15, 0.02, 0.7])
cbar = fig.colorbar(ScalarMappable(norm=norm, cmap=cmap), cax=cbar_ax)
cbar.set_label('Engine Displacement (cc)', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')

# Adjust layout
plt.tight_layout(rect=[0, 0, 0.9, 0.95])

# Save the figure
plt.savefig("figure.png", dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight')
print("Figure saved successfully!")
EOF
